freeze.reason: Trial 7 was an operational no-start because Binance USD-M returned HTTP 451 from both available collection environments. Trial 8 preserves the carry hypothesis using U.S.-accessible Coinbase spot and Bitnomial public first-party data. The originally planned 2026-08-20T02:00:00Z Trial 8 start produced no scientific observation because pre-start connectivity failed before any compact/raw candidate record was written. Product discovery was corrected to funding-first lookup, and the live direct product spec then established the exact machine identity of product_id 5614 as symbol/cqg_symbol PBTCUCZ50, base_symbol BTCUC, type perpetual, contract_size 0.01. Before any candidate observation, the identity validator was corrected to that live first-party schema and the prospective start remained 2026-08-20T03:00:00Z.
revisionLog: Before any Trial 8 observation, the Bitnomial funding URL was corrected to the first-party funding-rate endpoint documented by Bitnomial.

Before any Trial 8 observation, the broad product-spec list was found to omit the documented/CFTC-listed BTC perpetual during live connectivity. Product discovery was changed to funding history base_symbol=BTCUC -> most recent valid product_id -> direct product spec/data lookup by ID. No economic parameter changed.

Before any Trial 8 observation, the prospective start moved from 2026-08-20T02:00:00Z to 2026-08-20T03:00:00Z because the original boundary passed with zero scientific observations. Screening/final boundaries moved by the identical one-hour offset.

Before any Trial 8 observation, the live direct Bitnomial spec for funding-selected product_id 5614 showed symbol=PBTCUCZ50, cqg_symbol=PBTCUCZ50, base_symbol=BTCUC, product_name=Perpetual Bitcoin US Dollar Centi Future, type=perpetual, contract_size=0.01. The source identity rule was corrected from type=future / prose-name matching to the exact machine identity type=perpetual, base_symbol=BTCUC, PBTCUC-prefixed symbol or cqg_symbol, and contract_size=0.01. No economic parameter changed.

hypothesis: A static BTC cash-and-carry position that buys Coinbase BTC-USD spot and shorts the Bitnomial Bitcoin USD Centi perpetual earns positive net funding carry over 180 days after conservative retail spot costs, Bitnomial exchange/clearing fees, basis movement, stale-price gates, and margin stress.

perpetualShort.productName: Bitcoin US Dollar Centi Perpetual Futures

portfolio.contractCountRule: floor(targetNotionalUsd / (entryBitnomialPriceUsd * contractSizeBtc)), minimum 1 only when one contract notional is <= 25% of starting equity

fundingAccounting.shortFundingPnlRule: For each first-party Bitnomial funding interval whose interval_end satisfies startBoundary < interval_end <= endBoundary, short funding PnL = btcQuantity * mark_price * funding_rate.

sourceRules.bitnomialProductDiscoveryRule: Query the first-party Bitnomial funding endpoint with base_symbol=BTCUC; select the product_id from the most recent valid funding row; fetch the exact first-party product spec and product data by that product_id; require type=perpetual, base_symbol=BTCUC, symbol or cqg_symbol beginning PBTCUC, contract_size=0.01 BTC, and bind all funding rows to the same product_id. Product prose-name ordering is diagnostic only and is not an identity gate. Ambiguity or mismatch fails before economics.
sourceRules.bitnomialFundingCompletenessRule: Every regular 8-hour interval_end strictly after start and at or before end must be present; absent funding intervals fail the data gate rather than being synthesized or forward-filled.

antiLeakage.failureRule: After the first Trial 8 candidate observation, any change to venues, direction, BTC quantity rule, costs, collateral, window, funding accounting, stale-price rule, data substitution or stress rules requires a new trial number.
